text:
英语词汇 · GMAT · 第 94 单元

offender
音标：英 /ə'fendə(r)/  美 /ə'fɛndɚ/
n. 罪犯；冒犯者；违法者
短语：sex offender — 性犯罪者
短语：criminal offender — 罪犯；犯罪者
例句：Community punishment is used for less serious offenders.
社区服务刑被用来处罚犯罪情节较轻者。
例句：At 16, Scott was already a persistent offender (= someone who has been caught several times for committing crimes ).
斯科特16岁时就已经是个惯犯了。

season
